Booking shipments for orders placed via your Sendbox online store is super seamless, and you can do it on your mobile or laptop from anywhere in the world.


## In this post, we will cover:


1. How to book shipments for orders placed on Sendbox for business


Press enter or click to view image in full size


**How to book shipments for orders (website platform)**


Step 1: Log in to your Sendbox business account on sendbox.co/business


Step 2: From the blue sidebar, click on ‘’orders’’ (bottom left)


Step 3: Select the order you want to book a shipment for


Step 4: On the right toolbar, click on ‘ *ship* ’


Step 5: Input all the required shipping details and click on ‘ *ship order.* ’


**How to book shipments for orders (mobile platform)**


Step 1: Log in to your Sendbox business account on sendbox.co/business


Step 2: Tap on the three lines icon (hamburger button) on the top right of business dashboard


Step 3: From the blue sidebar, click on ‘orders’ (bottom left)


Step 4: Select the order you want to book a shipment for


Step 5: On the top toolbar, click on ‘ship’


Step 6: Input all the required shipping details and click on ‘ship order.’
